meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: Claude 会先读懂你的需求，用一行「设计解读」说明判断，并设定变化度、动效、密度三个旋钮，再据此为落地页、作品集或改版挑选设计系统或风格并写出界面，避开 AI 默认的模板化外观。
howto.when: 当你要做落地页、作品集或界面改版，或提到「极简」「Awwwards」等风格词、贴了参考链接时接管；不处理仪表盘、数据表格和多步产品 UI。

say.text: 帮我做一个面向技术买家的 SaaS 落地页，走 Linear 那种极简风
say.note: 它会先给一行设计解读，再动手写代码

say.text: 这是我现有网站，帮我重新设计，保留原有 logo 和品牌色
say.note: 改版会先审计现状再给方案

say.text: 把首页 hero 改成 Awwwards 那种实验性、动效更强的风格
say.note: 它会调高动效和变化度旋钮

howto.what_en: Claude first reads your brief, states a one-line Design Read, sets three dials (variance, motion, density), then picks a real design system or aesthetic family and builds landing pages, portfolios and redesigns that avoid templated AI defaults.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a landing page, portfolio or redesign, or mention vibe words like "minimalist" or "Awwwards", or paste reference links. Not for dashboards, data tables or multi-step product UI.

say_en.text: Build a SaaS landing page for technical buyers, Linear-style minimalist.
say_en.note: It states a Design Read first, then writes code.

say_en.text: Here is my current site; redesign it, keeping the existing logo and brand colors.
Make the hero more Awwwards-experimental with heavier motion.
say_en.note: It raises the motion and variance dials.
